_about: A probe, never published: what gpt-oss-120b takes of the card and of the environment's memory on the flagship's GPU server image, measured before its series is planned. Its experts (about 59 GiB in MXFP4) do not fit beside the rest in 24 GB, so --n-cpu-moe keeps the experts of the first N of its 36 layers in the environment's memory. Each N from most on the CPU to fewest, first with the weights mapped from the file and then read in with --no-mmap; the first N that does not come up ends that mode. The host gives the environment more memory for this block only and puts it back after. One slot of 8192 tokens, as the size curve's largest models have. The release's --reasoning off is left out: gpt-oss cannot turn its reasoning off, and probe-gptoss-1 finds what the server does with it; memory does not depend on it. Files carried in under /srv/line2, listed in /srv/line2/SHA256SUMS.
